text.en:
The retirement granted on recommendation of the Director of Civil Service and Secretary of
Justice on November seventeenth, nineteen hundred and twenty-six, to the late Judge Adolph Wislizenus of
the Twentieth Judicial District, who rendered continuous, faithful, and satisfactory service during more than
twenty-four years (October 7, 1902, to November 12, 1926), is hereby approved and confirmed, and the action
taken by the Governor-General on the application for said retirement shall be as effective as if said application
had been filed after December fourth, nineteen hundred and twenty-six, and as if the same had been acted
upon favorably prior to June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and twenty-seven, in accordance with the provisions
of Act Numbered Twenty-five hundred and eighty-nine, as amended by Act Numbered Thirty-three hundred

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, October 24, 1927.
